risks.trigger: Method Kernel runs before structural candidates and treats B0/WorkMap gaps as blocking.
risks.mitigation: Start only in shadow mode after PM/MoC/PF/OLC candidates exist; canBlockUserFlow=false.

risks.trigger: Methodological readiness is interpreted as Runtime readiness/reentry.
risks.mitigation: Separate Runtime readiness, methodological readiness, diagnostic readiness and production readiness in contract and tests.

risks.trigger: Conformance or consistency findings are translated into EVE pathology.
risks.mitigation: Prohibit diagnostic outputs; test no diagnosis, no IR, no pathology hints.

risks.trigger: WorkMap draft, B0 prefill or free text without provenance enters as captured evidence.
risks.mitigation: Require epistemic status and sourceRef; reject unconfirmed primary inputs.

risks.trigger: Methodological finding is worded as judgement about person, role or organization.
risks.mitigation: Limit output to model/evidence findings and manual review requests.

risks.trigger: Kernel reorders, promotes or excludes primary activities.
risks.mitigation: No selection outputs; run only after selection and structural candidate creation.

risks.trigger: Kernel critiques responsibility/activity writing during WorkMap intake.
risks.mitigation: Do not consume raw WorkMap as evidence; WorkMap Assistance remains separate chip.

risks.trigger: Runtime documents override D1 or define MMABP rules.
risks.mitigation: D1 remains primary methodological source; D4/D5 boundary-only assertions in tests.

risks.trigger: Registry marks Method Kernel as runtimeAuthority before implementation and tests.
risks.mitigation: No registry mutation in design; separate authorization task required.

risks.trigger: Method Kernel states are mixed with Runtime route/gate states.
risks.mitigation: Whitelist Method Kernel states and assert blocked_by_missing_canonical_route stays Runtime-only.
